evidence: Ingested training_data.csv into Hopsworks feature group leak_data v1 (800 rows) and computed per-class statistics on the platform via Trino (delta.mlpab596dd3_featurestore.leak_data_1, GROUP BY label). f2 separates the label perfectly with non-overlapping class ranges: label=0 has f2 in [-0.461, 0.372] (mean 0.004, sd 0.142) while label=1 has f2 in [2.085, 2.865] (mean 2.509, sd 0.147). The class max for label 0 (0.372) is far below the class min for label 1 (2.085), a standardized mean gap of ~17 sigma, so f2 predicts the outcome flawlessly. By contrast f1, f3, f4, f5, f6 are standard-normal noise: per-class means near 0 and sd ~1.0 for both classes, with fully overlapping ranges and negligible mean differences (<0.2). f2 is therefore the leaking feature.
